workflows.description: Run a lightweight autonomous garden pass on the Granite vault.

steps.prompt: Run /vibe_vault-garden focus=all against the Granite vault at {{config.vaultPath}}. Make only high-confidence changes and report what changed.

workflows.description: Scan important mail threads and decide whether a human follow-up is needed.

steps.prompt: Use /vibe_gog-mail. Review relevant client threads and decide whether a reply, review, or note update is needed. If human action is required, create Garden attention items through MCP or the Garden CLI.

workflows.description: Ingest a completed transcript into Granite using the meeting digest skill.

attention.title: Review transcript ingest for {{payload.title}}
attention.body: Workflow ingest-transcript finished. Check the generated Granite note, follow-up email, or extracted learnings.
